name: Omarchroma
author: NobleDoodle
description: True theme sync to all of your desktop applications, the easy way. Syncs your active Omarchy theme to all apps with toggles for GTK/GNOME, Qt/KDE Frameworks, Dark Reader (Web Apps), Pear Desktop (YouTube Music), Flatpak apps and additional browsers (Firefox, Zen, Floorp, Vivaldi and more), with a list of the applications still showing the previous theme. The syncing itself is done by hyprchroma, which this panel installs for you if it is missing.
